status.pending_review: Pending review - changes not yet committed

reasons.missingPre: Tool ran without an acknowledged tracking hook.
reasons.unmatchedTool: Tool tracking ended without a completion signal.
reasons.staleEvent: Late or contradictory tool events were ignored.
reasons.foreignTool: Hooks from another turn or a subagent were ignored.
reasons.suspiciousWindow: A tool exceeded the previous age threshold.
reasons.interrupted: Tracking was interrupted before its turn finished.
reasons.watcherLoss: The workspace file watcher was interrupted.
reasons.hookFailure: A tracking hook could not be delivered.
reasons.overlap: Earlier events were suppressed while ownership or tracking was uncertain.
reasons.competingOwners: Edits made while another session was running a command were not linked.
reasons.observationGap: Events arrived during an interrupted tracking window.
reasons.checkoutBaseline: Repository initialization could not be reconciled.
reasons.uninstrumented: Another agent session was active; links are shared, not exclusive.
reasons.unreportedSession: Edits made while an agent session without tool tracking was active were not linked.
reasons.throttled: File links could not be saved within the rate limit.
reasons.quota: The session reached its file tracking limit.
reasons.persistence: File links could not be saved.
reasons.readFailure: Changed files could not be inspected.
reasons.coveragePersistence: Tracking diagnostics could not be saved.
reasons.excluded: Unsupported or excluded file events were skipped.
